0022600191.text: The Knicks (3-4, 1-2 on the road) visit the Cavaliers (4-3, 3-1 at home) for New York's 9th game of the season, with Cleveland still having one game to play before this one. New York is on a one-game winning streak and sits 8th in the East, while Cleveland is on a one-game losing streak and sits 5th in the East. Josh Hart is out for New York with an ankle injury, and no Cleveland players are listed as unavailable, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27. In 2025-26 the Knicks won the season series 2-1 and then won the playoff series 4-0, with the most recent meeting a 130-93 Knicks win in Cleveland on May 25, 2026.
